What are the most important aspects of being a Senator?
1.Engaged Attendance:Presence at the monthly Senate meetings is essential,asa
quorum is needed to conduct our business.You are the voice of your colleagues,and
for equitable engagement,and helps build community,it is also possible to attend
remotely.Agendas and any supporting materials are distributed in advance of each
meeting,along with details on how to connect online.Attendance at any special events
is equally important(for example,a Senate-sponsored forum for the general faculty on
a specified topic)
standing or special committees.Depending on their individual skills or interests,some

recommend specific actions for consideration by the Senate as a whole.Committee

chairs work with committee members and the Senate staff to hold regular meetings
online or in person throughout the year.Committee business ebbs and flows and
workloads vary.Your committee may have pressing work to do one semester,andless
work the next This is not unexpected or unusual
3.Communication and Input:One of the essential functions of the Senate is to facilitate
communication among faculty and between them and the administration.Thismeans
that Senators seek input of colleagues in their home department(s)and likewise report
Senate business back to your department.
Please speak to your chair about including Senate business as a regular feature of
department meetings,if this is not already the practice in your department.Withsome
rare exceptions,the issues discussed in the meetings of the full Senate area matter of
public record.
